name: GetWhys
description:
Your team is shipping more content than ever at AI speed — but the gap between what goes out the door and what buyers actually think has never been wider. GetWhys closes it. It’s the buyer intelligence layer that sits across your whole AI stack, and this connector brings it right into Claude.

You’ve already done the hard work: the personas, the messaging frameworks, the brand voice. GetWhys makes all of it the standard every Claude conversation runs against automatically — so you can scale your judgment without scaling your hours, and bring the unbiased voice of the buyer into every draft, every campaign, and every leadership conversation. That’s a superpower your whole team inherits.

Once connected, your team can:
- Ask buyer research questions and get cited answers — pain points, decision criteria, pricing sentiment, and win/loss drivers, every insight traced back to its source in GetWhys research interviews. Real buyers, not AI guesses.
- Pull your personas, messaging frameworks, and brand voice into any Claude draft, automatically.
- Validate content before it ships — GetWhys scores copy against your target personas and shows you exactly what lands, and what to fix, while there's still time to fix it. 

And your work finally becomes visible: the GetWhys Usage Dashboard shows which personas and frameworks are driving improvement and how much better your team’s content is scoring — proof for leadership that your strategy is working. Best of all, only one or two power users ever need to touch GetWhys. They build the intelligence layer once; everyone else simply gets better output in the tools they already use. No training program, no 300-seat rollout.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GetWhys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GetWhys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.getwhys.io/mcp/org. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GetWhys MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GetWhys provides these MCP tools: get_all_messaging_frameworks, get_all_personas, get_brand_voice, get_messaging_framework, get_persona, list_messaging_frameworks, list_personas, query_market_research, score_content, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GetWhys?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GetWhys in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GetWhys requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GetWhys is developed by GetWhys. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
